name: nelcota-code-quality
description: Development-only NelcotaRules checks for the Rust, Svelte and SDK repository

scripts.format: oxfmt --config .oxfmtrc.json knip.config.ts knip.json package.json tsconfig.json .nelcota-rules.oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json .prettierrc.json crates/admin/ui sdk/typescript sdk/nextjs sdk/ssr lint && prettier --write "crates/admin/ui/src/**/*.svelte"
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check --config .oxfmtrc.json knip.config.ts knip.json package.json tsconfig.json .nelcota-rules.oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json .prettierrc.json crates/admin/ui sdk/typescript sdk/nextjs sdk/ssr lint && prettier --check "crates/admin/ui/src/**/*.svelte"
scripts.check:rules: bun run typecheck:rules && bun run typecheck:scripts && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run knip && bun run package-size && bun run test:rules
scripts.typecheck:scripts: bun lint/checks/typecheck.ts sdk/nextjs/scripts/tsconfig.json sdk/ssr/scripts/tsconfig.json sdk/typescript/test/tsconfig.json sdk/typescript/examples/tsconfig.json sdk/typescript/tsconfig.scripts.json sdk/ssr/examples/sveltekit/tsconfig.json crates/admin/ui/tsconfig.scripts.json sdk/nextjs/examples/app-router/tsconfig.json sdk/typescript/test/contract/tsconfig.json
scripts.prepare:checks: bun install --cwd sdk/typescript --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun run --cwd sdk/typescript build && bun install --cwd sdk/ssr --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --force && bun run --cwd sdk/ssr build && bun install --cwd sdk/nextjs --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --force && bun run --cwd sdk/nextjs build && bun sdk/nextjs/scripts/link-self.mjs && bun install --cwd sdk/ssr/examples/sveltekit --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun install --cwd crates/admin/ui --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
scripts.check: bun run prepare:checks && bun run --cwd sdk/typescript check && bun run --cwd sdk/ssr check && bun run --cwd sdk/nextjs check && bun run --cwd crates/admin/ui check && bun run check:rules
